title: Pending: run topic-modelling and extraction jobs automatically in the cloud
description:
## Context
Weekly topic modelling and extraction currently run by hand on a developer workstation. That stays the case for now. Later, these jobs (BERTopic topic modelling, topic-trends, cluster matching, typed extraction) should run on a schedule in the cloud, containerised (for example an AWS Batch job definition with a container image), not on someone's laptop. They cannot run inside a Lambda bundle (heavy optional dependencies).

Status: pending/backlog. Do not start. New cloud resources and schedules need explicit human approval before anything is created. Papyrus side: PPY-428252 and PPY-77bb3b describe the scheduled snapshot that consumes the outputs; this story is the producing side.

## Acceptance criteria (for when it is picked up)
```gherkin
Feature: Cloud job runner
  Scenario: Run a job in a container
    Given a container image with the job's optional dependencies
    When a job is submitted with a corpus location and a configuration
    Then it runs to completion without a developer machine
    And writes its outputs to the configured storage location

  Scenario: Scheduled weekly run
    Given an approved weekly schedule
    When the schedule fires
    Then the topic-modelling job runs and records its snapshot identifier
```
